readback.command: python -m pyocd commander --no-config -t cortex_m -u @UID_FILE -f 1000000 -O auto_unlock=false -O connect_mode=halt -O resume_on_disconnect=false -O cache.enable_memory=false -O cache.read_code_from_elf=false -O scan_all_aps=false -c status -c "savemem 0x08000000 @IMAGE_BYTES @RUN_ROOT/readback.bin" -c status -c exit
readback.length_rule: 长度 = 本轮候选 BIN 的字节数(由 @IMAGE_BYTES 机械展开, 与 S0 重算值绑定); 不是任意窗口
readback.expectation_basis: P0 的 S2_readback.stdout.txt 就是 'Core 0 (None):  Halted' 两条夹一条 'Saved <n> bytes to <path>'; 交付物判据是那个文件的字节数/散列/与镜像逐字节相等(READBACK_BYTE_COUNT / READBACK_HASH_MISMATCH / READBACK_NOT_BYTE_EQUAL_TO_IMAGE), stdout 里的工具文字不参与字节比较。
readback.length_note: Exactly 292684 bytes, equal to b424 BIN; no retry.

reset.command: python -m pyocd reset --method sysresetreq --no-config --no-wait --connect attach --core 0 -t cortex_m -u @UID_FILE
reset.expectation_basis: This action records rc=0 and raw tool output. Actual startup is checked by the passive boot capture, ps/free, and system_status READY/fault0 predicates; no apply or forced recovery is included.
reset.note: 工具内部定位该 UID 的行为不冒称零内部枚举。

observation_bounds.why: 这是**观测下界**, 不是对板子的断言: 从复位/开口到第一条查询之间, 主机至少要有这么长时间在听, 才有资格说它观察过启动。低于它而拿不到字节, 结论只能是'没观察到'

scope_this_package: Re-run ONLY the startup observation on the same b424 image after the operator powered VM (TMC motor supply) on. One explicit reset + one COM5 session: 75 s passive boot capture, then read-only ps / free / system_status / safety_status / motor_status. The new fact under test is the per-call IOIN attribution with VM powered: expect reason=ok instead of the previous reason=rx-timeout-echo tx=4 rx=4 flush=0 used=100. No download, no readback (b424 was proven byte-exactly on board by the previous session's 292684 B readback), no apply, no arm/start/learn/zero/commit/save, no log clear, no retry.

byte_integrity_policy.passive_boot: Existing dangerous-text gate only. Raw boot bytes must be separately reviewed for NUL/UTF8 and specific print completeness; generic dispatch success is not full print acceptance.
